thread:
julie_support: FYI customer reported a huge unexpected charge after a streaming call got cancelled mid-generation. Invoice vs dashboard mismatch (~3x). They attached request_id: r_2026_03_15_9987 and session trace.

maria_customer: We upgraded to the new streaming SDK yesterday. During a flaky mobile network connection one of our clients cancelled, then reconnected. Dashboard shows ~3.8k tokens but invoice billed ~12.5k for the same session. Request id above. Here's the client flow we saw:

```
SSE connect -> partial chunks (chunk seq 1..6) -> client cancel (HTTP close) -> client reconnect 2s later -> server final chunk emitted (empty final) -> client treats as final and closes
```

We think the reconnect may have triggered duplicate token accounting. Can you check? :grimacing:

ingrid_eng: Can you paste the raw request_id and any server trace IDs? Also which model and sequence length were involved?

julie_support: request_id r_2026_03_15_9987, trace ids: t-7f3a9 / t-7f3a9-handoff; model: redwood-rlhf-13b, typical seq len ~850. Customer says this started after switching to SDK v1.8.

metering-bot: [auto] Ingested session r_2026_03_15_9987: 2026-03-15T18:03:11Z start, 18:03:15Z client-cancel, 18:03:17Z reconnect, 18:03:18Z final-frame, tokens_counted: 12504, dashboard_aggregate_tokens: 3789.

sam_billing: Initial hypothesis: when client reconnects before runtime finalization we sometimes run a handoff path that flushes the KV-cache and re-emits a final frame, but metering currently sums tokens from both the pre-cancel and post-handoff streams if they share a session id. That would explain ~3x.

ingrid_eng: Pasted a short excerpt from runtime logs showing chunk seq and token deltas:

```
[18:03:11] seq=1 tokens=120
[18:03:12] seq=6 tokens=3200 partial
[18:03:15] client_close (no final flag)
[18:03:17] handoff.start trace=t-7f3a9-handoff
[18:03:17] reemit seq=6 tokens=3200 final
[18:03:18] reemit seq=7 tokens=8104 final-end
```

ingrid_eng: Looks like we re-emitted overlapping token ranges (seq=6 repeated) and metering counted both runs. The issue is the handoff path not deduping token deltas when the earlier stream didn't include a final marker.

julie_support: For immediate customer relief: billing is provisioning a credit while infra tracks a bug. Sam, can you confirm the credit amount math?

sam_billing: Provisioned a temporary credit of 8,800 tokens worth (covers the delta) and opened billing ticket BILL-4672 for invoice adjustment. We'll reconcile once infra confirms root cause and we have a repro.

devx_liz: We should also patch SDK to always emit a deterministic final event (final=true) on client-side cancel so the server can mark earlier partials as aborted. Also add an idempotency/session nonce header so reconnects with same session id are deduped on the metering layer. I'll open an SDK PR.

ingrid_eng: Repro steps we used locally (short):

1) open SSE stream to /v1/streams?model=redwood-rlhf-13b&session=sess-abc
2) stream partial tokens until seq 6
3) close connection (simulate mobile cancel) without sending final-event
4) wait 1.5s and reconnect with same session header
5) allow runtime handoff to re-emit final frames

curl snippet we used:
```
# simulate client close
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "X-Session: sess-abc" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=redwood-rlhf-13b" --max-time 2 || true
# reconnect immediately
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "X-Session: sess-abc" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=redwood-rlhf-13b"
```

ingrid_eng: On the server side we pushed a hotfix to ensure the metering pipeline treats re-emitted frames for the same session and overlapping seq ranges as idempotent; this prevents double-counting. Will monitor for the next 24h.

sam_billing: Noted. Once we see <1% regression on the affected cohort we'll finalize invoice adjustment. Customer credited now and I'll hold the invoice change pending infra signal.

maria_customer: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. ETA for final invoice change?

julie_support: Sam expects final reconciliation within 48 hours after infra verifies metrics. We'll follow up with BILL-4672 and a summary here when done. :thumbsup:

maria_customer: Great, thanks.

julie_support: (closing loop) infra confirmed hotfix deployed to the metric-aggregator at 2026-03-15T21:12Z and initial sampling shows correct counts for the customer sessions. Leaving the thread open until billing posts the adjustment.
